title: Remove Settings OCR path evidence flat exports
summary: Removed eight transitional flat Settings OCR path evidence aliases while preserving the helpers on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The OCR path evidence helpers are still namespace-exported and are consumed through dependency injection within Settings modules rather than direct window.* access, so their flat aliases can be retired safely.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed BDPGS and VobSub OCR path evidence helpers both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and as direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: The BDPGS and VobSub OCR path evidence helpers remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView and existing Settings module dependency injection, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 460 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_ocr_path_evidence_helpers_are_namespace_only_exports asserts the OCR path evidence helpers remain present while direct flat aliases are absent.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before source edit because window.settingsBdpgsOcrPathEvidence still existed.

rg "window\.settingsBdpgsOcrPathEvidence|window\.settingsVobSubOcrPathEvidence|window\.renderSettingsBdpgsOcrPathEvidence|window\.renderSettingsVobSubOcrPathEvidence" apps\desktop\webview\static tests\webview Docs\inventories -n returned no matches after removal.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the eight Settings direct window.* OCR path evidence aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 460 to 468.
